item.name: Get paginated transactions with merchant info by customer ID

request.name: Get paginated transactions with merchant info by customer ID

description.content:
Retrieves transactions for the specified customer ID, including merchant details, using pagination.
Default page size is 1000, but you can adjust it with query parameters.

query.description: Database username (optional if using default from environment).
Database password (optional if using default from environment).

variable.description: (Required) The customer ID to filter transactions.

response.name: Successful response with paginated transactions.

item.name: Get top buyers for a customer

request.name: Get top buyers for a customer

description.content: Retrieves the top buyers for a given customer, ranked by total transaction amount.

query.description: Database username (optional, uses environment variables by default).
Database password (optional, uses environment variables by default).

response.name: A list of top buyers sorted by total amount transacted.

item.name: Get top sellers for a customer

request.name: Get top sellers for a customer

description.content:
Retrieves the top sellers (suppliers or service providers) for a given customer,
ranked by total transaction amount.

query.description: Database username (optional, uses environment variables by default).
Database password (optional, uses environment variables by default).

response.name: A list of top sellers sorted by total amount transacted.

item.name: Get top buyers for a customer in the last X months

request.name: Get top buyers for a customer in the last X months

description.content: Returns the top buyer-type merchants for a customer over the last `months` months,  where the time window is anchored to the customer's most recent transaction date.

query.description: Number of months to look back from the last transaction date.

response.name: A list of top buyer merchants

item.name: Get top sellers for a customer in the last X months

request.name: Get top sellers for a customer in the last X months

description.content: Returns the top seller-type merchants for a customer over the last `months` months,  where the time window is anchored to the customer's most recent transaction date. Seller interaction types include: `Seller`, `Supplier`, `Service provider`, and `Agency`.

query.description: Number of months to look back from the last transaction date.

response.name: A list of top seller merchants
